buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address The Commandant Naval War College C/o INS Mandovi Verem Goa-403109 . 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. 1. The seller should preferably have a registered office in the state of buyer location and documents for address proof to be submitted with the bid. However, in case if the bidder is selected as L1 firm, i t has to open a working office in the locality of the bidder. It is further submitted that this condition i s not restrictive and solely been included for better administration of the manpower related matters. 2. 2. Minimum service charge is not below than 3.85%. A self declaration certificate must be attached f or quoting not below 3.85%. 3. 3. Bid security declaration be submitted instead of EMD as per GOI/MOE letter no F.9/4/2020-PPD da ted 12 Nov 20. 4. 4. Acceptance of ATC-A self declaration to be made by the bidder at the time bidding quoting accep tance of all terms and condition and ATC mentioned in the bid documents. 5. 5.Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a.Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 6. 6. NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: I M/s.(Bidder Name/ staff name) hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification,plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract and the successful bidder has to ensure that all the staff deployed at buyer locati on should also furnish the same declaration. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 7. 7. An interview will be undertaken by the BOO after award of the bid for selection of the staffs and t

he successful bidder must provide joining letter, monthly salary slip and experience certificate to all the staff deployed at buyer location during and after conclusion of the contractor respectively. A dec laration for the same must provided by the bidder at the time of bidding. 8. 8. The Industrial Relations Code (IR Code), 2020: 9. 8.1. Contractor providing services of contracted employees cannot terminate their services abruptly without a prior notice of 14 days. 10. 8.2. Grievance Redressal Committee (GRC): A Grievance Redressal Committee (GRC) is to be establi shed, if a unit establishment has 20 or more employees (including outsourced workers) for resolutio n of workplace grievances. All outsourced workers are to be provided with the access to GRC. 11. 8.3. Standing Orders (applicable for department with strength of workers in excess of 300). Model St anding Orders must be promulgated for Organisations/establishments with 300 or more workers. Co ntractor must abide by the departments' standing orders regarding discipline, conduct, working hou rs, termination, etc. 12. 9. The Code of Social Security, 2020: 13. 9.1. EPF (Employees' Provident Fund) (applicable when contractor employs 20 or more workers). Co ntractor must register workers under EPF and a monthly deposit of relevant share (12% to be contri buted by employer and 12% by the employee) must be credited. A monthly ECR (Electronic Challan- cum-Return) with respect to such deposits must be retained by the contractor. Principal Employer must verify that PF is being deposited and obtain PF compliance certificate every month. 14. 9.2 ESI (Employees' State Insurance) (applicable when monthly wages of the employees are below R s.21,000/-). Contractor must register eligible workers under ESIC and contributions must be deposite d on a monthly basis. They are also to ensure medical, sickness and disablement benefits. Principal Employer must verify ESI compliance and maintain ESI details of each worker. 15. 9.3. Maternity Benefit Act (for female outsourced workers). Contractor must provide paid maternity leave as per the law and Principal Employer must ensure no discrimination in employment condition s. 16. 9.4. Employees' Compensation (if ESI not applicable). If a worker is not covered under ESI, then the contractor must provide compensation for injury, disability or death on duty, as applicable. Principal Employer must ensure insurance coverage for the employees through the contractor. 17. 9.5 "The contractor shall comply with the code on Wages, Industrial Relations Code, Social Security Code and Occupational Safety, Health & Working Conditions Code. Wages shall be paid as per the re vised definition of 'Wages'. PF/ ESI challan, wage transfer proof, attendance records and statutory re gisters shall be submitted monthly before invoice acceptance." 18. 9.6 Strike/ Lockout Notice Clause: "The contractor shall ensure continuity of services and comply wit h the provisions of the Industrial Relation Code, 2020 related to strike/ lockout. Any disruption witho ut statutory notice shall be treated as breach of contract". 19. 9.7 GRC Clause: "All employees shall have access to the establishment's Grievance Redressal Com mittee. The contractor shall cooperate with the GRC as required." 9.8 Standing Orders Compliance: "Deployed personnel shall adhere to the Standing Orders of the est ablishment as per the IR Code, 2020." 20. 9.9 EPF Compliance: "Contractor shall ensure EPF coverage for all deployed employees as per the C ode on Social Security, 2020. Monthly ECR and payment receipt shall be submitted to the Principal E mployer". 21. 9.10 ESI Compliance: "Contractor shall provide ESI benefit as per Social Security Code, 2020 and su bmit monthly contribution challans". 22. 9.11 Accident/ Insurance Clause: "In case a worker is not covered under ESI contractor shall ensure coverage under Employees' Compensation insurance". 23.

9.12 OSH Compliance Clause: "The contractor shall comply with Occupational Safety, Health and W orking Conditions Code, 2020 during execution of the contract". 24. 9.13 Working Hours Clause: "Working hours shall follow OSH Code norms. 8 hours/day, 48 hours/we ek;overtime shall be paid at double rate". 25. 10. Wage-Related Compliance (As per The Code of Wages, 2019): 10.1. As per the new definition of "Wages", Basic Pay + DA must work out to minimum 50% of total wages 26. 10.2. Emoluments like PF, ESI, Bonus, Leave, Gratuity must be calculated on the wages as defined a bove. 27. 10.3. Minimum Wages notified by Government of India must be compulsorily adhered to. 28. 10.4. Units shall hold separate files for maintaining records of contract labour compliance, monthly statutory compliance checklist, digital copies of all PF/ESI challans, contract license details, wage re gisters & attendance. 29. 11. The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (OSH) Code, 2020: 11.1. Safety and Health Measures at Workplace: Units must ensure safe working environment, PPE & uniforms (where applicable), drinking water, sanitation, first-aid box and rest arrangements. Man datory free annual health check-ups for contracted employees are to be provided by the employers. 30. 11.2. Occupational Health, Medical Check-Ups: The contractor must conduct periodic medical check -ups and maintain health records for security personnel, cleaning staff and those employed in roles of dangerous industrial jobs. OSHA-compliance penalty is to be applied, if ignored. 31. 11.3. Working Hours & Overtime: Daily working hours for outsourced employees should be restricte d to a maximum of eight hours with a weekly limit of 48 hours. Overtime workers are to be paid double wa ges as per the OSH Code. Women can work at night, only with consent and safety arrangements. 12. Bidder should submit GST registration Number & HSN code of the pertinent services. 32. 13. Retention of sourcing power an Non-levy of sourcing fees: - The successful bidder shall mandato rily absorb/retain at least 80% of the existing experienced operational personnel currently deployed at the Buyer's premises, subject to their satisfactory performance, background verification, and me dical fitness. the incoming contractor shall issue fresh deployment/ engagement letters to such retai ned staff within 7 days of contract award without charging any registration, recruitment, administra tive or onboarding fee directly or indirectly from the personnel. failure to retain the mandated perce ntage without explicit written permission from the buyer shall constitute a breach of contract. . 8. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 9. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff.
